facts.fact: UNESCO says the education ministry's SIGE holds national data, collected regularly by the ministry, which a March 2026 workshop analysed for the 2023-2024 and 2024-2025 school years, with school-health indicators being integrated into it.

systems.system: Système d'Information et de Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)

facts.fact: The document says the education ministry has committed to setting up and operationalising a SIGE, and EUMC is recruiting a consultant to strengthen it for integrating JIGITUGU.

UNESCO says Mali's education ministry planning unit (CPS) collected 2023-24 national data on school-health indicators integrated into the SIGE and analysed them at a Segou workshop on 21-26 October 2024.
